title_or_table: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE), counties, people under 18 in poverty
table_id: SAIPE timeseries, SAEPOVRT0_17_PT, time=2019 and time=2024
geography: Counties and county equivalents in the 50 states and DC
universe_or_base: Related children and other people under 18, under the official poverty measure
unit: child_poverty_pct in percent, with its 90 percent margin of error in percentage points; children_in_poverty in people
vintage: SAIPE 2024 release; 2019 as currently served by the data API
qualification: Model-based estimates under the official poverty measure, which counts pretax cash income and leaves out tax credits such as the child tax credit; the national rate was 16.8 percent in 2019 and 15.5 percent in 2024. printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates, people under 18 in poverty, 2019 and 2024, counties in the 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Model-based estimates under the official poverty measure, which leaves out tax credits.
